instruction:
Three-Storey Terrace Housing Conversion

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required output as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 12 IfcWall entities, at least 3 IfcSlab entities, and at least 5 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: TERRACE-UNIT-1-A, TERRACE-UNIT-1-B, TERRACE-UNIT-2-A, TERRACE-UNIT-2-B, TERRACE-1, TERRACE-UNIT-3-A, TERRACE-UNIT-3-B, and TERRACE-2.
7. TERRACE-UNIT-1-A and TERRACE-UNIT-1-B are assigned to one storey; TERRACE-UNIT-2-A, TERRACE-UNIT-2-B, and TERRACE-1 are assigned to a second storey; and TERRACE-UNIT-3-A, TERRACE-UNIT-3-B, and TERRACE-2 are assigned to a third storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [22.0, 4.0, 10.5].

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.

command: if exist "C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Archicad 29\Archicad Starter.exe" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
